#######################################################################################
# WebGPU expectations categories format
#
#  At the end of the line we add '# CAT:'  and then a comma deliminated categories.
#
#  Known categories:
#          Accuracy - A small deviation in output that is not significant in practice
#                     eg. tanh inaccuracies, sampling in cubemap corners
#          Critical - A significant error that could impact users and needs investigation
#                     eg. integer arithmetic errors,
#          Spurious - Failure due to practical limitation. Similar to WGSL Spurious failure.
#                     eg. compiler stress test, slow coverage testing
#
#  Examples:
#   crbug.com/123 [ android ] webgpu:shader,execution,limits:* [ Skip ] # CAT:Spurious
#
#######################################################################################

################################################################################
# Permanent Skip Expectations
#
# The "Skip" expectations in this section are expected to never be removed.
# This is for things like tests that will never be supported on a particular
# platform/configuration.
################################################################################
